name: Mika Ingebrigtsen
location: The Circuit — neon-lit entertainment and vice district, near North Ave and Damen
description:
Mika Ingebrigtsen is tall and rawboned, the kind of frame that suggests either malnutrition or efficiency depending on the decade. At 31, he has soft features that belie the chrome underneath — people underestimate him once, usually only once. The chrome is visible — hydraulic joints in knees and elbows — absorbs falls, amplifies strikes — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He grew up in the Narrows, where the walls are so close together you learn to fight in confined spaces or you learn to lose. He works as a smuggler out of The Circuit, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

In a city full of people who talk about what they'll do, Mika Ingebrigtsen is one of the ones who actually does it.

core_fears: Losing their edge to age — the body slows before the mind accepts it
Never being able to stop running — the lifestyle is a trap disguised as freedom
That the work they do makes the city worse, not better
core_desires: Freedom from augmentation debt — the interest compounds like a tumor
To protect the people in their district who can't protect themselves
To prove everyone who dismissed them catastrophically wrong
coping_mechanisms: Compartmentalization — work feelings and personal feelings exist in separate boxes
Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Overwork — takes every contract offered because idleness invites thinking
blind_spots: Trusts technology more than people — machines don't betray
Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
psychology.secret: Obed Belov-Ntim killed someone who didn't deserve it on a job three years ago and has never told anyone. The face appears in dreams weekly.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Terse to the point of rudeness. Treats words like ammunition — expensive and not to be wasted.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and dense — information-heavy sentences that demand attention.
verbal_tics: Whispers when angry — the quieter the voice, the worse the situation
Refers to killing as 'solving' — clinical detachment as coping mechanism
example_lines: "Contraband is just cargo that hasn't been properly introduced to the right people."
"Every border is a suggestion. Every checkpoint is a negotiation."
"I move things from where they are to where they need to be. The legality is your problem."

story_hooks: A crew member from Obed Belov-Ntim's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Obed Belov-Ntim's reputation — and a price for silence
Someone is impersonating Obed Belov-Ntim on jobs, and the impersonator is better at the work than the original
narrative_function: Obed Belov-Ntim represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. His stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Hydraulic joints in knees and elbows — absorbs falls, amplifies strikes. Synthetic muscle fiber replacement in legs — doubles sprint speed, terrible on stairs
daily_life: Between contracts, maintains a cover identity — mundane work, mundane hours, mundane neighbors. The transition from civilian to runner and back requires a conscious effort that gets easier with practice and more disturbing with self-awareness.

strengths: mechanical aptitude — can repair or modify almost anything
weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions

decision_rules: Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm — it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Advocates caution to others but takes insane risks personally — double standard they can't see
Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
habits: Sleeps with one hand on a weapon — has done this for so long it's not deliberate anymore
Takes a specific route home every time, varying only one block per trip — paranoia as lifestyle
Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything — late once, nearly died, never again
Keeps a physical paper notebook — no digital record of personal thoughts
breaking_points: Running out of options — no contacts, no money, no safe house, no way out
Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity

physical_description.heritage: Distinctly East Asian-dominant heritage (39.9%) creating sharp facial geometry — high cheekbones, defined jawline, and characteristic eye shape — substantially warmed and softened by Hispanic/Latin American ancestry (26.2%) that brings warmth and golden undertones to his complexion. Eastern European (11.5%), Northern European (10.1%), and South Asian (9.0%) contributions add subtle complexity: slight broadness through the upper face from Eastern European ancestry, additional warmth and depth from South Asian genetics, and fine details in bone structure from Northern European heritage. The result is a striking phenotype where East Asian angularity is tempered by warm, olive-golden skin tones and subtle facial fullness from his Latin American and South Asian admixture — a face that reads as genuinely global rather than regionally locked.
physical_description.build: Rawboned and lean — long limbs with minimal body fat, the frame of someone who moves through tight spaces regularly. Visible muscular definition in shoulders and forearms despite the wiry appearance; the synthetic muscle fiber in his legs creates a subtle asymmetry in bulk when flexed.
physical_description.hair_style: Short, practical cut — no styling, functional. Kept neat but not fussed over.
physical_description.eye_color: Warm brown, natural — unremarkable and deliberately forgettable, carrying the calm assessment of someone who catalogs exits and threats automatically
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-olive complexion — East Asian base enriched with Hispanic/Latin American and South Asian undertones creating a unified warm complexion that catches light distinctly, with subtle olive warmth throughout
physical_description.complexion: Sharp facial structure refined by his mixed heritage — high, East Asian-derived cheekbones creating distinctive angles softened by warmth from Hispanic/Latin American and South Asian ancestry, complemented by a defined jawline with subtle fullness. Skin is clear with the exception of minor scarring around the left temple (old blade work). No facial hair; keeps himself cleanly shaved. Eyes carry a calm assessment, the gaze of someone who catalogs exits and threats automatically.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Hydraulic joint assemblies at elbows and knees — visible chrome pistons and flex-seals, no attempt at concealment. The joints have a burnished, well-maintained appearance. When he moves, the hydraulic assist is subtle but noticeable in how he absorbs impact; a fall from height that would break a natural's legs registers as barely a stumble. Synthetic muscle fiber in legs creates visible scarring along the lateral thigh where the integration was done — parallel lines of raised tissue running from hip to knee.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision — no wasted motion, every step purposeful. Carries himself slightly forward-leaning, as if perpetually assessing distance and angles. In confined spaces (stairs, corridors, crowded venues), he navigates with an almost predatory grace. At rest, his posture is relaxed but alert; hands rarely still, fingers constantly repositioning. The hydraulic augmentations give him a rhythm — a subtle metallic whisper on each step.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical wear — function over fashion, but with an edge. Typically wears dark cargo pants with reinforced pockets and extra webbing (for gear distribution), steel-toed boots scuffed from actual use, and fitted compression shirts in black or grey that show off the augmentation scarring without advertising it. Over this, a distressed synthetic leather jacket (weathered charcoal) that's seen real wear. When undercover in his mundane identity, he adopts generic Tier 3 worker clothing — basic corporate-adjacent wear that lets him disappear into crowds. No visible jewelry; no affectations.
distinguishing_marks: Thin scar running from left temple to upper cheekbone — approximately 7cm, pale and well-healed, suggests knife work
Small tattoo on inner right wrist: three vertical lines with a horizontal slash through them (Narrows gang marker, obsolete affiliation)
Burn scar on right shoulder blade, roughly 4cm diameter, circular — old industrial contact burn

image_prompt: Lean, rawboned man of mixed global heritage — East Asian facial geometry with warm golden-olive complexion blended from Hispanic/Latin American and South Asian ancestry, high sharp cheekbones softened by golden undertones. Dark brown hair, short and practical. Warm brown eyes with calm, assessing gaze. Height 188cm, defined muscular shoulders and forearms. Wearing distressed charcoal synthetic leather jacket, dark reinforced cargo pants, steel-toed boots. Compression shirt showing synthetic muscle scarring on lateral thighs.
